 Order

This petition is filed seeking the following reliefs :
(i) To i ssue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the concern respondents to decide/consider the representation of the petitioner dated 21.02.2025 and 21.02.2025 produced as Annexure P/3 and P/4.
(ii) To Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the concern respondents not to interfere with or encroach upon the petitioner's land bearing Khasra Nos.314/5-315/5 (area 0.809 hectare) and Khasra Nos.
314/6,315/6, 314/8, 315/8 (area 0.405 hectare), situated at Mouza Kathotiya, R.N.M. Babai Kala,
Tehsil Gadarwara, District Narsinghpur, except by due process of law.
(iii) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the concern respondents to carry out the road construction strictly in accordance with the sanctioned map and alignment (Annexure P/7) and not to curve or divert the road into the petitioner's land.
(iv) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the concern respondents to immediately Kanhaiya Lal Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196297086/
1 conduct proper demarcation of the petitioner's land as per his pending application (Case No.
RS/452/0736/1077/2025) and ensure that road construction work does not encroach upon the petitioner's property.
(v) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the concern respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner, if any portion of his land is required to be acquired for road construction, in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
(vi) Issue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit.
2.

sentences.text: It is pointed out that a representation/application has been filed by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:43015 2 WP-34917-2025 petitioner before the respondents-authorities concerned in terms of Annexure P/2 which is pending consideration and has not been decided till date.
An innocuous prayer is made to direct the respondent No.2-Collector District Narsinghpur (M.P.) to consider and decide the pending representation expeditiously.
3. Counsel appearing for the State has no objection to the limited prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner.

4. In such circumstances, this petition is disposed of by directing the petitioner to file a certified copy of this order to the respondent No.2 who, in turn, is directed to consider and decide the pending representation (Annexure P/2), if not already decided, within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

5. Needless to mention that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
6.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of finally in above terms.
